_primary_source: Official FIFA in-app rules feed: https://play.fifa.com/json/fantasy/help_pages.json (how_to_play, EN; corroborated by DE/ES/FR sections in the same feed). This is the same text FIFA renders at https://play.fifa.com/fantasy/help/rules.

scoring._note: Appearance is +1 for ANY minutes played; there is NO additional point for reaching 60 minutes (both the <=60 and 60+ rows are +1). Clean sheet, save and goals-conceded scoring require/relate to 60+ minutes as noted. Captain doubles all of a player's points (incl. negatives). Bonus rows below apply to every position.

MID._note: MID has NO goals-conceded penalty. Tackles/chances-created points apply only to MID.

FWD._note: FWD has NO clean sheet and NO goals-conceded penalty. Shots-on-target points apply only to FWD.

goal_from_direct_free_kick.note: Additional to the goal points, any position.

scouting_bonus_differential.condition: Player scores MORE THAN 4 pts in a match AND is selected by fewer than 5% of all teams.

not_present_vs_FPL: No separate larger appearance bonus for 60+ minutes (both bands are +1).
No BPS/'bonus points' POTM-style 1-2-3 system; the only bonuses are the direct-free-kick +1 and the scouting differential +2.
Red card is -2 (FPL is -3); own goal -2 (same as FPL).

squad.ko_budget_note: Team Budget increases by $5m for the knockout phase. Applied automatically once Round 3 locks and Round of 32 transfers open.

nation_cap._label: Max players per Country, by stage

formation_constraints.note: Exactly 1 GK in the starting XI; outfield split must match one of the 7 listed formations. Default formation is 4-4-2.

captain_rules.vice_captain: Scores double ONLY if the captain plays zero minutes AND you made no manual changes during the live round.
captain_rules.auto_assignment_on_first_save: Most expensive player = Captain, second most expensive = Vice-Captain.
captain_rules.changes: Captain/VC can be changed unlimited times before lockout, and during a live round provided the new captain's team has not yet played and the old captain has completed his match. Changing captain mid-round forfeits the old captain's double.
captain_rules.interaction_with_qualification_booster: If the captain is eligible for the Qualification Booster +2, that +2 is NOT doubled.

bench_substitution_rules.bench_priority: Outfield bench players are ordered 1-3; priority 1 is first to replace a DNP starter (must keep a valid formation). GK bench replaces GK only.
bench_substitution_rules.auto_subs: Happen at the END of a round, replacing DID-NOT-PLAY starters, ONLY if no manual change was made during the live round.
bench_substitution_rules.manual_subs_live: Allowed if the bench player has not yet played and the outgoing player's match has ended (not in progress); resulting XI must be a valid formation. After a manual sub you only score the incoming player. ANY manual change (sub or captain change) cancels auto-subs for that round.
bench_substitution_rules.bench_scoring: Bench players accrue points but do not count toward your score unless brought on via sub/auto-sub.

transfers.extra_transfer_penalty_note: Each transfer beyond the free allocation deducts 3 points. Deducted once the round locks out and players begin scoring.

rollover.scope: Group stage only (one free transfer carries to the next group-stage round). Cannot carry from Round 3 into Round of 32 because that window is unlimited.

transfers.locks_at: First match of the FIFA World Cup 2026 kicks off Thursday 11 June 2026 (20:00 +01:00 per rounds feed). Unlimited changes until then; thereafter a fixed per-round transfer lockout plus a rolling per-match lockout for live team changes.
transfers.irreversible: Once confirmed a transfer cannot be reversed. Transfers made during a live round apply only from the next round.

chips.name: Wildcard
chips.what_it_does: Make unlimited transfers within a single round at no points cost.
chips.when_usable: Any single round EXCEPT Matchday 1 (first match of group stage) and EXCEPT the Round of 32. Cannot be reversed once confirmed.

chips.name: 12th Man
chips.what_it_does: Add 1 extra player (not already in your squad) who scores points for that round. The 12th man cannot be substituted, captained or transferred; budget and per-team limits do not apply to this pick.
chips.when_usable: Any single round. Can be deactivated before the round locks out.

chips.name: Maximum Captain
chips.what_it_does: Doubles the points of whichever starting-XI player scores the most that round; that player is auto-assigned the captaincy.
chips.when_usable: Any single round. Can be deactivated before the round locks out.

chips.name: Qualification Booster
chips.what_it_does: +2 points to each starting-XI player who progresses to the next knockout round (or wins the final), provided they play at least 1 minute. If the captain is eligible, this +2 is not doubled.
chips.when_usable: Round of 32 onwards (knockout stage only). Can be deactivated before the round locks out.

chips.name: Mystery Booster
chips.what_it_does: Unrevealed as of 2026-06-05; revealed once Round 3 locks and the Round of 32 window opens. App API internal name is 'booster/clean-sheet' (suggesting a clean-sheet-related mechanic), but FIFA has not published its effect. Usable for one knockout-stage round including the Final.
chips.when_usable: One round of the knockout stage (incl. Final), after it is revealed at Round of 32. Can be deactivated before the round locks out.

chips_general.rules: One booster per round; multiple boosters cannot be combined in the same round. Each booster usable only once across the tournament. All except the Wildcard can be deactivated before the round locks out (API: booster/revert).

confidence._basis: All values taken verbatim from FIFA's own in-app rules JSON (help_pages.json, how_to_play). English and German/Spanish sections agree on every number. Only the Mystery Booster's effect is genuinely unknown (FIFA states it is revealed at R32); the 'clean-sheet' API name is a hint, not confirmation.

notes: AUTHORITATIVE: this file's numbers come from FIFA's own rules feed, not memory or third-party blogs.
Goal values are GK 9 / DEF 7 / MID 6 / FWD 5. A WebSearch snippet claiming '6 for GK/DEF, 5 MID, 4 FWD' was WRONG; the official feed and two specialist sites confirm 9/7/6/5.
Appearance gives +1 for any minutes; unlike FPL there is NO extra point at 60 minutes (both bands +1).

This 2026 scoring (tackles/chances/shots thresholds, scouting differential bonus, direct-FK bonus, 9/7/6/5 goals, $100m+$5m budget) matches the FIFA Club World Cup 2025 Fantasy engine, not the 2022 WC Fantasy or FPL.
Stages map to 8 rounds: group MD1-3, then Round of 32 (48-team format -> 32 in KO), R16, QF, SF, Final.
Nation cap rises with the bracket: 3/3/4/5/6/8.
Mini-leagues, country/confederation leaderboards exist but are out of scope for this brief.
